Essays explain the ideas behind the guidelines. The principles, the languages,
and the tools are made for looking things up while working; an essay is made
to be read once, from start to finish, to understand why. It shows how rules
that are stated in different places follow from one idea, why the idea matters
for research software, and where it reaches its limits. In the terms of
Diátaxis, the essays are explanation
([](../principles/documenting.qmd#sec-diataxis)).

An essay states no rules. Where it touches one, it cites the principle, the
language, or the tool that states it, so that each rule stays in one place.
